item.title: [ransomware] England Hockey investigating ransomware data breach
item.description: England Hockey, the governing body for field hockey in England, is investigating a potential data breach after the AiLock ransomware gang listed it as a victim on its data leak site. [...]

item.title: [ransomware] AI-generated Slopoly malware used in Interlock ransomware attack
item.description: A new malware strain dubbed Slopoly, likely created using generative AI tools, allowed a threat actor to remain on a compromised server for more than a week and steal data in an Interlock ransomware attack. [...]

item.title: [ransomware] US charges another ransomware negotiator linked to BlackCat attacks
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice charged another former DigitalMint employee for his involvement in an insider scheme in which ransomware negotiators secretly partnered with the BlackCat (ALPHV) ransomware operation. [...]

item.title: [ransomware] Please Don’t Feed the Scattered Lapsus ShinyHunters

item.title: [ransomware] INC Ransomware Group Holds Healthcare Hostage in Oceania
